dispositionPolicy.falsePositiveThreshold: strict proof: affected code absent, unreachable, non-shipped, out-of-scope, or materially misunderstood
dispositionPolicy.fixPhilosophy: minimal scoped fixes by default; repeated maintained-code vulnerability classes may use existing helpers or a doctrine-correct package-local/tooling/driver/foundation helper after live source and barrel discovery

sanitation.publicFindingPolicy: Tracked ledgers carry title, severity, owner area, disposition, rationale, changed files, and verification. Full reports and Codex patch bodies stay in gitignored raw evidence.

lanePolicy.validationWrites: sub-agents return structured verdicts; main agent writes ledgers
lanePolicy.remediationWrites: workers may edit only assigned disjoint paths; main agent owns shared helpers and integration

stopConditions: Chrome cannot access the authenticated Codex security findings page.
Sanitization scan finds a secret in tracked files, or raw evidence is staged.
A legitimate maintained-code finding cannot be remediated without an explicit policy or architecture decision outside this packet.
A proposed helper would violate architecture doctrine and no local fix is viable.
Yeet or hosted CI exposes a security/check failure that cannot be attributed to environment or unrelated baseline after investigation.
Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
mission: Capture, triage, remediate, and close every open Codex Cloud security finding for `beep-effect` in one PR on `security/codex-findings-2026-07-08`. The end state is a merged PR, no unresolved PR comments or failing CI jobs, and zero open Codex security findings.
